description: Removes the incident report from a status page with all its updates. Irreversible. Underlying monitors and incidents in Statuser are not affected — only the public publication is removed.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_incident_report_delete
title: Delete incident report from status page
